title: The Erie Canal
source: Song "Low Bridge, Everybody Down" by Thomas S. Allen (written 1905, published by F. B. Haviland, New York, 1913; Allen d. 1919). Words as printed in Carl Sandburg, The American Songbag (1927), "The Erie Canal", pp. 171-172, which reads "Fifteen miles"; Allen's 1913 sheet reads "Fifteen years" (and "I've got an old mule"). Both are pre-1930 public-domain texts; Sandburg's is used whole.
license: Public domain (composer died over 70 years ago); arrangement original, CC0
